user.title: Connect to Strava
user.description:
Enter your Strava API credentials to link your account.

In the Strava developer portal set the Authorization Callback Domain (or URL) to {callback_url}. The Home Assistant UI will handle the redirect even if your instance is only available locally.

Strava will ask you to grant the `read` and `profile:read_all` scopes so Home Assistant can download your bike list.
